name: Chandan

meta.title: Builder
meta.summary: AI engineer and founder. Built and deployed four products in two years — an AI hiring platform (Mindfries), an autonomous ground vehicle navigation stack (DRISHTI-UGV), an exam grading engine (OzymorLab), and AI workflow systems at Sendlume. Smart India Hackathon 2025 national finalist. Open-source contributor to CodeGraphContext, sktime, AOSSIE, and Stability Nexus.

bullets: Built an AI-powered website auditing pipeline that scans pages for broken links, missing metadata, structural HTML problems, and SEO gaps.
Added an LLM recommendation layer that turns raw diagnostic data into prioritized fixes — no one has to inspect every page by hand.
Shipped multi-agent systems for business intelligence — trend discovery, knowledge management, strategy automation.
Built an AI Strategy Intelligence Platform with agent orchestration, analytics, and production-ready APIs.
Worked directly with leadership to turn business requirements into deployed software.
Founded an open-source platform automating the full exam lifecycle: management, rubric design, evaluation, grading, analytics.
Built a production assessment engine using OCR, LLMs, and explainable AI to convert handwritten answer sheets into auditable evaluations.
Redesigned prompt pipelines, cutting LLM token costs from 3M to 20K per workflow (99% reduction).
Built a pixel-level email tracking microservice processing 10,000+ events/day with an async event queue.
Shipped a node-based AI workflow canvas backed by a stateless REST API for non-technical users.
Built a real-time analytics dashboard with WebSocket streams and Redis-cached PostgreSQL aggregations. Sub-100ms latency.
Maintained infrastructure on Neon, Redis, Docker.
